description: LIVE on-chain read of one reserve via AaveProtocolDataProvider — current rates (supply/variable/stable APY), totals (aToken/stable/variable debt), indexes, plus config (LTV, liquidation threshold/bonus, reserve factor, active/frozen flags), token addresses (aToken/sDebt/vDebt), and caps. Authoritative current-block snapshot for a single asset.
name: get_live_reserve_detail
